callPath: JWT authentication and DB permission loading
password and mustChangePassword updated; refresh tokens revoked

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated PostgreSQL with real ADMIN JWT; not rerun this turn. Saw reset 200, new login SUPER_ADMIN, privileged endpoint 200 while mustChangePassword=true.
Current source same baseline; code read this turn.

counterevidenceChecked: mustChangePassword flag and separate force password endpoint
audit metadata attempted but writeAudit swallows storage errors
observedImpact: With a valid default ADMIN session, operator can reset SUPER_ADMIN password and log in as SUPER_ADMIN; historical probe reached privileged backup/restore table endpoint.
potentialImpact: Password update and refresh revocation are independent calls; if revocation fails after password update, previous refresh token may remain valid. This failure was not injected in this package.
recommendation: Check actor and target rank/protected account in the backend command; enforce force-change mode server-side across business routes; define transactional/recoverable semantics for credential write, session revocation and required audit.

Permitted normal-target reset invalidates old refresh sessions
force-change user cannot use ordinary business endpoints
revocation/audit failure has documented consistent state semantics
